description: This file defines the OrderSearchCriteria class, which encapsulates various filtering parameters for querying Order entities in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties such as patient, care setting, concepts, order types, date ranges, order status, and other criteria, along with constructors and getter methods. It is intended to be used with the OrderSearchCriteriaBuilder for building search queries.

classes.name: OrderSearchCriteria
classes.description: Represents the search parameters for querying Order entities, allowing filtering by patient, care setting, concepts, order types, date ranges, and other order attributes.

methods.name: OrderSearchCriteria
methods.description: Constructor for initializing an OrderSearchCriteria object with detailed filtering parameters, including patient, care setting, concepts, order types, accession and order numbers, date ranges, order status, and flags for including voided or canceled orders.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with the order search criteria.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Returns the care setting associated with the order search criteria.

methods.name: getConcepts
methods.description: Returns the collection of concepts that the order must be associated with.

methods.name: getOrderTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of order types the search will filter on.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Returns the visit associated with the order, if specified.

methods.name: getAccessionNumber
methods.description: Returns the accession number filter, case-insensitive exact match.

methods.name: getOrderNumber
methods.description: Returns the order number filter, case-insensitive exact match.

methods.name: getActivatedOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders activated on or before this date.

methods.name: getActivatedOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders activated on or after this date.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Returns whether to filter for stopped orders.

methods.name: getAutoExpireOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders auto-expiring on or before this date.

methods.name: getCanceledOrExpiredOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders canceled or expired before this date.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the specific action associated with the order.

methods.name: getFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Returns the fulfiller status filter for orders.

methods.name: getIncludeNullFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Returns whether null fulfiller statuses are included in the filter.

methods.name: getExcludeCanceledAndExpired
methods.description: Returns whether canceled and expired orders are excluded.

methods.name: getExcludeDiscontinueOrders
methods.description: Returns whether discontinue orders are excluded.

methods.name: getIncludeVoided
methods.description: Returns whether voided orders are included.
